untertitel: Estimate the order of magnitude of your possible reduced earning capacity pension under SGB VI.
hinweis: You do not need a care level for the reduced earning capacity pension — and a care level does not increase it either. SGB VI contains no supplement tied to one; care levels govern benefits of the long-term care insurance under SGB XI. What determines the amount are your earnings points, the supplementary period and the deduction.

schritt1.untertitel: Basis for the supplementary period and the deduction
schritt1.eintrittHinweis: The day from which your earning capacity is reduced — not the day you applied.

schritt2.untertitel: Determines the pension type factor under § 67 SGB VI
schritt2.label: Which situation applies?
schritt2.voll: Full reduction (less than 3 hours a day)
schritt2.teilweise: Partial reduction (3 to under 6 hours a day)
schritt2.hinweis: What counts is how many hours a day you can still work under normal labour market conditions. A partial reduction yields half the pension.
schritt2.berufsunfaehig: Unable to work in my trained occupation (§ 240 SGB VI)
schritt2.berufsschutzText: Because you were born before 2 January 1961, a pension for occupational disability is also available. It is measured against your trained occupation rather than the general labour market — a lower hurdle. It yields half the pension.
schritt2.berufsschutzEntfallenText: For anyone born on or after 2 January 1961 the legislator abolished the pension for occupational disability. What counts is solely how many hours you can still work on the general labour market, regardless of your trained occupation.

schritt3.hinweis: The exact figures are in your pension statement from the Deutsche Rentenversicherung. An estimate is enough for the order of magnitude.

ergebnis.auszahlung: Paid 12 times a year, before health and long-term care insurance contributions
ergebnis.wartezeitOk: The general qualifying period of five years is met (§ 50 (1) SGB VI).
ergebnis.wartezeitFehlt: The general qualifying period of five years is not yet met (§ 50 (1) SGB VI). Without it there is no entitlement.
ergebnis.voraussetzungen: In addition, § 43 (1) no. 2 SGB VI requires three years of compulsory contributions within the last five years before the onset. That can only be checked against your insurance record.
ergebnis.aufschluesselung: How the amount is made up
ergebnis.epZurechnung: Earnings points from the supplementary period (§ 59 SGB VI)
ergebnis.keinAnspruchText: Your birth cohort no longer has occupational protection. Check instead whether a full or partial reduction in earning capacity under § 43 SGB VI applies.
ergebnis.hinzuverdienstHinweis: You may earn up to this amount alongside the pension without it being reduced. For a partial reduction the limit depends on your earnings points; the average salary you entered is used here.
ergebnis.laeuftBis: Pension paid at the latest until
ergebnis.laeuftBisHinweis: Pensions for reduced earning capacity end when you reach the standard retirement age; the old-age pension then takes their place. Yours is {jahre} years and {monate} months.

aktionen.antragText: Create it in the letter centre

disclaimer: This is a non-binding estimate without the basic pension supplement, the higher valuation of training periods and other special rules. Entitlement and amount are decided solely by the Deutsche Rentenversicherung after a medical assessment.
